View 1078 Nicola St V6G 2E2 rent availability including the monthly rent price and browse photos of this 3 bed, 2 bath, 1253 Sq. Ft. house. 1078 Nicola St is currently on market.
TO SET UP A VIEWING OR FOR INQUIRIES CONTACT:  Viewing Agent at viewings @orcarealty. ca or TEXT ONLY (6O4) 757- 548O      Discover a serene oasis in the heart of Vancouver's West End with this modern 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom townhouse. This light-filled corner unit is nestled in a quiet, European villa-inspired setting surrounded by lush greenery. Engineered hardwood floors and geothermal in-floor heating provide both comfort and energy efficiency throughout the home.    The main floor features a spacious living and family area with high ceilings and large pane windows, offering a tranquil view of the historical complex. The chef-inspired kitchen comes equipped with a large gas stove, stainless steel appliances, and a kitchen island for added storage and dining space. An intimate patio provides a peaceful outdoor retreat. The second floor includes in-suite laundry, two versatile bedrooms, and a bathroom with premium quartz countertops. The top-floor master loft sanctuary boasts ample space, a double sink vanity, luxury stone tiles, and private patio access. Additional amenities include underground parking that fits a midsize SUV, a storage locker, and access to a bike room.    HOME FEATURES & AMENITIES  Corner Unit  Geothermal In-Floor Heating  Chef-Inspired Kitchen  Private Patio Space  Underground Parking & Storage  Bike room
